separateState: last successfully applied criteria or absent
searchReturn.beforeNew: Capture raw and prior state; no criteria validation, search or forced selection needed
searchReturn.returnUnsearchedOrUnapplied: Restore raw four values and exact state on cancel/discard/save; no automatic search even if an older applied set exists, no reset to employment 01, no fake 0-count
searchReturn.returnSearched: Re-fetch with prior successfully applied criteria only; cancel selects prior member, save selects saved employee only if still a result member; clamp/restore scroll, no substitute employee
searchReturn.clear: Reset initial criteria/employment01, invalidate result/selection, wait unsearched; no automatic search
searchReturn.PH-05: Basic specification gap defined by BUI-05/UI-P01/UI-P02; old product remains unverified until current downstream build/runtime evidence

saveBoundary.F04: Current unapplied detail is validated/reflected before explicit save; employee 1 plus all intended careers atomic; reflect/remove only edit the buffer; validation/DB failure retains all values/current tab/selection; unknown result stops repeat save and follows existing result enquiry
saveBoundary.F06: Explicit current code 1 only; fixed employment category remains read-only; cancel discards just pending edit and rereads current persisted key when required
saveBoundary.navigation: App menu/back/logout/target change checks unsaved parent/detail/buffer; MSG-015 approved means displayed discard result, rejected/closed means continue editing. Browser history/reload/close warning capabilities must be verified without claiming custom dialog equivalence
saveBoundary.authenticationExpiry: No automatic save or cross-session draft restoration; existing authenticated failure rules prevail
